name: gizza-ai/base85-codec
summary: Encode and decode Ascii85, Z85, and RFC 1924 Base85

tool.description: Encode text or hex bytes to Base85, or decode Base85 back to text or hex. Supports Ascii85 (Adobe/btoa with z shortcut and optional framing), Z85 (ZeroMQ), and RFC 1924 variants.

input.description: The text or hex bytes to encode, or the Base85 string to decode.

mode.description: Direction: 'encode' (default) turns data into Base85, 'decode' reverses it.

variant.description: Base85 flavour. 'ascii85' is Adobe/btoa with the z zero shortcut and optional <~ ~> framing; 'z85' is ZeroMQ Z85 and requires byte lengths divisible by 4; 'rfc1924' uses the RFC 1924 alphabet.

format.description: How to read input when encoding, or render decoded output. 'text' (default) is UTF-8; 'hex' is a hex byte string for binary data.

adobe_frame.description: Ascii85 encode only: wrap output in Adobe <~ and ~> delimiters. Ignored for Z85/RFC 1924; decode strips Ascii85 framing automatically.
